verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs explicitly state the Linux package 'includes services and tools to install GitLab without laborious configuration' and also offer Helm chart/Operator and scaling guides for self-managed setups, directly matching the story. However, this is first-party documentation only, and community reports describe real operational pain for self-managed instances (backup/replication failures, performance issues) that suggest running GitLab reliably long-term is not as friction-free as the install claim implies. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that initial install is truly low-effort, and resolution of community-reported operational complexity post-install.
